observations: For Robin: the V2 USB delta 'mouth X in [-1.8, -0.8]' contradicts L2.1.6/L3.1.6.1 under the A7 centred-grid rule. On a 90 x 45 board the first grid column is X 5.63, so the Pico's first pin (1.37 from its PCB edge, mouth 1.3 beyond the edge) puts the mouth at X 2.96 at best; a mouth at X -0.8..-1.8 puts the first pin at X 0.87..1.87, off-grid by >= 3.7. Both cannot pass. Graded as written.

For Robin: the V2 request text says only 'a mounting hole in each corner'; the 2.5 mm inset and dia 3.0 come from variants.json 'about' and grading_deltas, which the agent does not see. The only source the agent has is parts/perfboard/part.json (inset 2.0, dia 2.0, from the E1-01 photo). Either the request or the catalogue needs to carry the variant's hole pattern for this to be fair. Graded as written.

Pico PCB edge (Y=12.0) touches jack bodies 1 and 2 (Y 0-12) face to face with zero clearance over X 20.75-26.75 and 42.0-48.0, Z 2.5-3.5: legal under L3.1.4.1 (0 mm3) but no assembly tolerance on a hand-built perfboard.
Install clearance L3.11.1.1 passes only by 0.243 because the eccentric standoffs reach within 0.243 of the V-SEAT column boundary; it would grow once the standoffs are centred on the holes.
Corner lid bosses are external cylinders (OD 6.6) that poke 0.2 mm into the cavity corners; the lid lip is notched around them (lip-to-boss gap 0.25). Not a defect.
Renders checked: model_iso/front/back/left/right/top, open_iso/top, ghost_iso/left. No floating fragments, lid right way up, openings on the faces the numbers say.
